[b]TKS Graf Eisenwald Deployed in Search and Rescue Mission[/b]

[i]The Kaiserreich announced Sunday that the TKS Graf Eisenwald would be deployed into the Nestor ocean to search for any survivors in the SS Leviathan disaster. The TKS Graf Eisenwald, a Hohenkrone-class helicopter carrier, had been deployed in the Nestorstaat region before being sent on a search and rescue mission. Carrying 14 Valkenheim-145 Luchs search and rescue helicopters, the Reichswehr Marineinfantriekorps will be searching the area for survivors in order to return them to Western View. The Hochkaiser from the Imperial Court for State Affairs in Neudresden announced the deployment of the TKS Graf Eisenwald on its humanitarian mission shortly after Head Councilman Tony Messaions called upon the nations of the Nestor ocean to aid in the search. The Kaiserreich hopes for the safe and swift return of those lost at sea to their families. To aid in this endeavor the Graf Eisenwald carrier will be deployed to the area, in coordination with Western View authorities, to conduct search and rescue missions, the Hochkaiser told reporters.  

-Kaiserreich Foreign Ministry-[/i]
